# Research Paper: Reinforcement Learning with Curriculum-inspired Adaptive Direct Policy Guidance for Truck Dispatching
## 1. Title
Reinforcement Learning with Curriculum-inspired Adaptive Direct Policy Guidance for Truck Dispatching
## 2. Abstract

This paper introduces a novel approach combining curriculum learning with direct policy guidance for reinforcement learning in truck dispatching. The method, termed Curriculum-inspired Adaptive Direct Policy Guidance (CADPG), addresses the complexities of dynamic mining environments by adapting policies through curriculum learning. Experimental results demonstrate the method's effectiveness in enhancing efficiency and reducing operational costs in truck dispatching scenarios.
## 3. Introduction
### 3.1 Problem Statement

Truck dispatching in open-pit mining is a complex task due to dynamic environments, uncertain task distributions, and real-time decision-making requirements. Traditional methods often rely on complex reward engineering and value-based approaches, which are challenging to design and may not generalize well.
### 3.2 Importance

Efficient truck dispatching is crucial for reducing operational costs and improving productivity in mining operations. Effective dispatching strategies can optimize resource allocation and enhance overall operational efficiency.
